lines.text: The people of Judah make sixteen-year-old Uzziah king, and he reigns in Jerusalem fifty-two years.
Uzziah seeks God in the days of Zechariah, and he tears down the walls of Gath, Jabneh, and Ashdod.
The Ammonites bring tribute to Uzziah, and his fame spreads as far as the border of Assyria.
Uzziah enters the temple to burn incense, and Azariah and eighty priests tell him he has no right.
Leprosy breaks out on Uzziah's forehead, and he lives in isolation while his son Hananiah governs the people.
